diagnoses: Status post right total knee arthroplasty on 2026-10-08

notes.text:
HISTORY:
78 y/o female s/p right TKA on 10/08.  Lives with daughter in a one-story home.

FUNCTIONAL STATUS:
- Ambulation: Pt ambulates 150 ft with a front-wheeled walker, no physical assistance required. Gait slow but steady.
- Bathing: Pt showers seated on a shower chair. Daughter stands nearby for safety during showers; no hands-on assistance needed.
- Transfers: Independent sit to stand using armrests.

ASSESSMENT/PLAN:
Continue gait training 3x/week. Goal: ambulate with cane by discharge.

Electronically signed by: PT, DPT

VITALS:
BP 132/78, HR 72, afebrile.

MEDICATIONS:
Reviewed medication list with patient. Patient fills her own weekly pillbox every Sunday and takes medications without reminders. Taking amlodipine 5 mg daily, apixaban 2.5 mg twice daily, and acetaminophen 650 mg as needed for knee pain.

ASSESSMENT/PLAN:
Incision clean and dry. Reinforced fall precautions.

Electronically signed by: RN
